module.name: Caught Below — Skellfold
module.description: Installed situations share this persistent world.

entities.name: the foot of the beck lane
the head of the tub incline
the climb up to the fell track
the fell track down to the quarry
A fall from a rotten ladder
entities.effect: Deal (1d6) physical damage to ally unless dexterity save against (12).

entities.name: Lash {world__ladder} to a line before anyone climbs
Strike with the Longsword of Flames

actions.name: Attack {opponent}
actions.description: Fight someone who is not peaceable. Townsfolk and the people you came to help are not offered as targets.

actions.name: Ask {companion} to come with you
actions.report: {companion} falls in beside you.

actions.name: Let {companion} make their own way
actions.report: {companion} nods, and lets you go about your business.

actions.name: Take {service} from {host}
actions.report: You eat a hot supper and sleep eight hours in a dry bed.

actions.name: Ask {healer} for {service}
actions.report: {healer} cleans and dresses every wound in the company.

actions.name: Buy one {goods} from {seller}
actions.report: {seller} counts the coins and hands over one {goods}.

actions.name: Make camp at {site}
actions.report: You find what shelter there is, and sleep in turns.

actions.name: Tell {recipient}: {statement}
actions.report: You explain what the evidence establishes. The listener accepts your account and sets aside a conflicting assumption; their next choices remain their own.

actions.name: Ask {informant} about {topic}
actions.description: Ask about an offered topic. The speaker shares an established fact they actually know.
actions.report: The speaker shares an account they know. You record it in your journal.

actions.name: Destroy {witness}
actions.report: You destroy this source of evidence. Existing knowledge and other sources remain.

actions.name: Have {caster} use {technique} on {recipient}
actions.description: Use a known healing, cleansing or persistent ward ability outside combat. Its normal mana cost is paid; combat cooldowns do not apply.
actions.report: {caster} tends {recipient} with {technique}.

actions.name: Rest and recover at {site}
actions.description: Spend six hours and one shared ration at a safe shelter. Living companions recover HP and mana; bleeding is treated. Poison and death remain. Other people and deadlines continue.
actions.report: You eat, bind your hurts and sleep for six hours.

actions.name: Accept {gift} for {recipient}
actions.report: {recipient} studies {gift} until {lesson} comes easily.

actions.name: Collect {find} for {recipient}
actions.report: {recipient} takes {find}.

actions.name: Buy {find} for {recipient}
actions.report: {merchant} takes the money and hands {find} to {recipient}.

actions.name: Equip {tool} on {wearer}
actions.report: {wearer} readies {tool}.

actions.name: Use {dose} on {recipient}
actions.report: {recipient} takes {dose}.

actions.name: Give {cargo} to {recipient}
actions.report: {carrier} hands {cargo} to {recipient}.

actions.name: Set down {cargo}
actions.report: {carrier} sets {cargo} down.

actions.name: Train {student} in {lesson}
actions.report: {mentor} spends an hour drilling {student} in {lesson}.

actions.name: Ask Hob about the workings
actions.description: Speak with someone here about an offered topic.
actions.report: 'Ladder down to the lower gallery's rotten. Has been for years. Take a line if you go down it. Or go round by the side drift and the tub incline; it's longer, but it'll hold you.'
actions.speaker: world__smith

actions.name: Lever {rescue__rack} up with {rescue__bar}
actions.report: You get {rescue__bar} under {rescue__rack} and lean on it. It lifts a hand's breadth, and {rescue__guest} drags the leg clear: bruised and cut, but whole.

actions.name: Dig out beneath {rescue__rack} with your hands
actions.report: It takes most of an hour of scraping grit and stone with bare hands. At last {rescue__guest} eases the leg out from under {rescue__rack}.

actions.name: Dig out beneath {rescue__rack}, the way a miner would
actions.report: Twenty minutes of quick, careful digging, shoring as you go. At last {rescue__guest} eases the leg out from under {rescue__rack}.

actions.name: Heave {rescue__rack} off by main force; {lifter} lifts
actions.report: {lifter} gets a shoulder under {rescue__rack} and heaves. It comes up, then the grip slips and it crashes down on its side. {rescue__guest} screams; the leg is broken.

actions.name: Set and bind {rescue__guest}'s broken leg
actions.report: The leg is straightened and splinted between two lengths of wood. {rescue__guest} goes white, then manages to stand.

actions.name: Ask {rescue__relative} what is wrong
actions.description: Speak with someone here about an offered topic.
actions.report: '{rescue__guest} went up to {world__quarry} at first light and should have been back by mid-morning,' says {rescue__relative}. 'Nobody has seen them since. The short way in is {world__beck_lane}, and {rescue__water} will close it at about watch {rescue__closesAt(rescue__water)}; after that you go the long way round. Please. Go and look.'
actions.speaker: rescue__relative

actions.name: Speak with {rescue__relative}
actions.description: Speak with someone here about an offered topic.
actions.report: {rescue__relative} takes your hands in both of theirs. 'You brought them back yourselves. I won't forget it.' Six coins are pressed into your palm: everything in the purse.
actions.speaker: rescue__relative

actions.name: Speak with {rescue__relative}
actions.description: Speak with someone here about an offered topic.
actions.report: 'They found their own way back, on that leg,' says {rescue__relative}, not quite looking at you. 'You got them out. I'm grateful. But you might have walked them back.' Three coins, counted out carefully.
actions.speaker: rescue__relative

actions.name: Ask how {rescue__guest} is mending
actions.description: Speak with someone here about an offered topic.
actions.report: 'Grumbling, which is a good sign,' says {rescue__relative}. 'You're welcome at this door any time.'
actions.speaker: rescue__relative

actions.name: Ask {rescue__guest} what happened
actions.description: Speak with someone here about an offered topic.
actions.report: 'It came down on me when I leaned on it,' says {rescue__guest} through their teeth. 'I can't shift it from under. There's {rescue__bar} in {world__smithy}, if you can fetch it. Or dig me out, if you've the time. Don't just haul on it; I heard something crack already.'
actions.speaker: rescue__guest

actions.name: Ask {rescue__guest} what they mean to do
actions.description: Speak with someone here about an offered topic.
actions.report: 'Home,' says {rescue__guest}. 'If you're going that way, I'll come with you. If not, I'll manage. I'm not sitting down here another hour.'
actions.speaker: rescue__guest

actions.name: Ask {rescue__guest} what they mean to do
actions.description: Speak with someone here about an offered topic.
actions.report: 'I can't walk on it,' says {rescue__guest}. 'Not alone. Give me an arm and I'll hop the whole way if I have to.'
actions.speaker: rescue__guest

actions.name: Speak with {rescue__guest}
actions.description: Speak with someone here about an offered topic.
actions.report: 'I owe you,' says {rescue__guest}. 'Next time I'll leave the old workings to the rats.'
actions.speaker: rescue__guest

rules.say: {rescue__relative} hurries over to you. 'Are you going up to {world__quarry}? Have you seen {rescue__guest}?'
A voice from low down in the dark: 'Here! Over here. Mind {rescue__rack}; it's on my leg. Don't just haul on it. Something cracked when it came down.'
{rescue__water} closes over {world__beck_lane}. That way is shut now.
{rescue__relative} sees {rescue__guest}, and runs. For a while nobody says anything sensible.
{rescue__guest} limps in and sits down hard by the hearth.

observations.text: A ladder of soft, black wood goes down the shaft. Two rungs are already gone.
A line runs from a piton beside the shaft down along the ladder, lashed at every third rung.
The ladder hangs in pieces at the bottom of the shaft.
Peat smoke, a tally-stick rack by the door, and a window that looks straight up the fell at the quarry.
Snow lies thin on the green and thick on the walls. The beck path runs up the valley; a steep track climbs the fellside.
The beck lane climbs between drystone walls toward the quarry. Snow is already curling over the walls into it.
Wind, and a long view of grey fell. The track drops toward the quarry from above.
Spoil heaps, a smithy with cold chimney, and the black mouth of the adit in the quarry face.
Tongs, wedges, a cold forge.
The adit runs straight into the hill. A side drift slopes away to the left.
A wide gallery of split slate. In the floor, a square shaft drops into darkness.
Rails run steeply down into the dark: the old tub incline.
Low and wet. Rails end in a tangle where an ore tub has jumped them.
{rescue__guest} lies half under {rescue__rack}, one leg trapped beneath it. Their face is grey with pain and cold.
{rescue__guest} keeps their weight off one leg, but can walk.
{rescue__guest} cannot put any weight on the broken leg.
{rescue__guest} sits with the bad leg up on a stool while {rescue__relative} scolds and feeds them.
{rescue__relative} stands with one hand shading their eyes, watching the way to {world__quarry}.
{rescue__relative} keeps a hand on {rescue__guest}'s sleeve, as if they might vanish again.
{rescue__rack} lies across the floor where it fell, wedged against the wall.
{rescue__rack} has been levered up and wedged on a lump of stone; there is space beneath it now.
{rescue__rack} lies where it fell, but a hollow has been scraped out of the floor beneath one end.
{rescue__rack} lies tipped on its side against the wall, one end split where it dropped.
{world__beck_lane} is still clear, but {rescue__water} will close it at about watch {rescue__closesAt(rescue__water)}.
{rescue__water} has closed {world__beck_lane}.

objectives.text: {rescue__relative} asked you to find {rescue__guest} in {world__quarry}. {rescue__water} closes {world__beck_lane} at about watch {rescue__closesAt(rescue__water)}.
{rescue__guest} is back with {rescue__relative}, who will want a word with you.

installations.name: Skellfold and the high quarry: Skellfold and the high quarry
installations.description: A slate-quarrying hamlet under the fell, and the old workings above it, in the first week of snow.

installations.name: Someone caught below: Someone caught below
installations.description: Someone went into old workings and has not come back. A fallen weight pins them; the short way out will close.
